Add gap finder for uncovered opening hours

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

after.hourglass/gaps.py:
# owner: platform
"""Find the stretches of opening hours that nobody is covering."""

from typing import Iterable, List

from hourglass.parsing import format_span
from hourglass.models import Span
from hourglass.merging import merge_spans

def _check_inside(worked: Iterable[Span], hours: Span) -> None:
    for span in worked:
        if span.start < hours.start or span.end > hours.end:
            raise ValueError(f"{format_span(span)} is outside opening hours")

def _uncovered(worked: Iterable[Span], hours: Span) -> List[Span]:
    merged = merge_spans(worked)
    lefts = [hours.start] + [span.end for span in merged]
    rights = [span.start for span in merged] + [hours.end]
    return [Span(left, right) for left, right in zip(lefts, rights) if left < right]

# ---
def find_gaps(worked: Iterable[Span], hours: Span) -> List[str]:
    """One label per uncovered stretch, such as 'gap 12:00-13:00 (60 min)'."""
    worked = list(worked)
    _check_inside(worked, hours)
    return [
        f"gap {format_span(span)} ({span.minutes} min)"
        for span in _uncovered(worked, hours)
    ]
after.tests/test_gaps.py:
# owner: platform
import unittest

from hourglass.parsing import parse_span
from hourglass.gaps import find_gaps

# ---
def spans(*texts):
    return [parse_span(text) for text in texts]

class FindGapsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    # ---
    def test_gap_between_shifts(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            find_gaps(spans("09:00-12:00", "13:00-17:00"), parse_span("09:00-17:00")),
            ["gap 12:00-13:00 (60 min)"],
        )

    # ---
    def test_gaps_at_both_ends_and_overlaps(self):
        worked = spans("10:00-12:00", "11:00-13:00")
        self.assertEqual(
            find_gaps(worked, parse_span("09:00-14:00")),
            ["gap 09:00-10:00 (60 min)", "gap 13:00-14:00 (60 min)"],
        )

    # ---
    def test_full_coverage_and_nobody(self):
        hours = parse_span("09:00-17:00")
        self.assertEqual(find_gaps(spans("09:00-17:00"), hours), [])
        self.assertEqual(find_gaps([], hours), ["gap 09:00-17:00 (480 min)"])

    # ---
    def test_outside_opening_hours_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            find_gaps(spans("08:00-10:00"), parse_span("09:00-17:00"))
